saints.name: St. Thomas Aquinas
saints.title: Priest and Doctor of the Church
saints.shortBlurb: The “Angelic Doctor,” Dominican friar whose Summa Theologiae joined faith and reason so profoundly that the Church has held him up as a master of theology…
biography: Born about 1225 at Roccasecca near Aquino, Thomas joined the Order of Preachers against his family’s wishes and studied under St. Albert the Great. He taught at Paris and in Italy, producing the Summa contra Gentiles and the unfinished Summa Theologiae, works that set out the Catholic faith with unmatched order and depth.

Late in life, after a mystical experience at Mass, he laid down his pen, saying all he had written seemed “as straw.” He died on 7 March 1274 on the way to the Council of Lyons. His feast is kept on 28 January, the translation of his relics.
saints.knownFor: The synthesis of faith and reason; the Summa Theologiae; Eucharistic hymns such as the Pange Lingua.

canonization.canonized: 1323 by Pope John XXII; declared a Doctor of the Church in 1567 by Pope St. Pius V

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 7 March
